data.message: Which 5 customer states have the highest share of late deliveries?
data.question: Which 5 customer states have the highest share of late deliveries?

steps: Join orders and customers tables to get the customer state for each order.
Calculate the total number of delivered orders and the number of late deliveries (where order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date) by customer state.
Compute the share of late deliveries as late deliveries divided by total delivered orders per state.
Rank the states by this share in descending order and select the top 5.

args.purpose: Compute share of late deliveries by customer state
args.sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_state,
    COUNT(*) as total_delivered,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as late_deliveries,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) as late_share
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY late_share DESC
LIMIT 5;

args.answer: The 5 customer states with the highest share of late deliveries for delivered orders are Alagoas (AL) at 23.9% (95 late out of 397 delivered), Maranhão (MA) at 19.7% (141 / 717), Piauí (PI) at 16.0% (76 / 476), Ceará (CE) at 15.3% (196 / 1,279), and Sergipe (SE) at 15.2% (51 / 335).
caveats: Restricted to orders with order_status = 'delivered' and non-null actual and estimated delivery dates.
